implementation: PC default-status/refresh/set/cancel/recover through existing workbench CLI and independent authenticated profile. Explicit epoch/nonce/expected job ID; set also requires installed name and durable revision. Bounded96-byte writes in32-byte chunks, nonce-frozen128-byte latest-job snapshots with sequence recheck and optional epoch/operation/job matching. No auto retry or fallback. ACK only accepted; UNKNOWN, saved, rendered, canceled and refresh completion remain distinct.

integration.external: Pipes replace TLS/USB; synthetic AUTH and epoch, controlled umount failure, manual stepping of existing native worker. No substitute success state machine.
